notes.subject: גרפם
notes.rationale: Verb 'to bear off violently' appears only here; 'swept/rausim' is the standard guess.

notes.subject: קדומים
notes.rationale: 'Pristine heroes / ancient' — hapax; renderings range from 'ancient river' to 'heroic host'.

notes.subject: נחל...נחל...נחל
notes.rationale: Triple repetition of 'wara' frames the verse; force kept by repetition.

notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש is life-force/breath, not 'bel'; Tok Pisin 'bel' covers seat of feeling.

notes.subject: תדרכי נפשי עז
notes.rationale: 'My soul, tread down strength' vs 'march on with strength' — verb-object vs adverbial reading.

translation: Wara bilong Kison i rausim ⟨ol⟩, wara bilong ol man bipo, wara bilong Kison. Bel bilong mi, yu wokabaut wantaim strong!
